changelog: Llama Studio 1.4.1: Windows is now a single self-contained EXE; Linux release (tar.gz) with the full application; built-in auto-update on both platforms (Windows replaces the single EXE, Linux swaps the installation folder with rollback); fixed minimize-to-tray and start-minimized on Windows; floating monitor window settings now persist; official llama.cpp builds only on the releases page.
